lead.title: Databricks hits $188B valuation, extending its run as AI's favorite second act
lead.summary: Databricks raised approximately $3 billion in a funding round led by Coatue, pushing its valuation to $188 billion. The company continues to dominate the AI data and infrastructure sector as enterprises race to operationalize machine learning pipelines at scale.

top_stories.title: Apple sues OpenAI for intellectual property theft
top_stories.summary: Apple has filed a lawsuit against OpenAI accusing the company of stealing intellectual property, marking a major escalation in tensions between the iPhone maker and the AI leader.

top_stories.title: OpenAI unveils its first hardware product
top_stories.summary: OpenAI released its first physical hardware device, expanding beyond software into the hardware space for the first time.

top_stories.title: General Compute lands $400M loan for inference chip infrastructure
top_stories.summary: Upper90 provided $400M in debt financing backed by inference-specific chips as collateral, signaling a shift toward inference chip financing as the next frontier in AI hardware debt markets.

top_stories.title: NVIDIA Vera Rubin maximizes intelligence per dollar for post-training workloads
top_stories.summary: NVIDIA detailed how its Vera Rubin architecture optimizes cost per token and post-training economics for agentic AI, positioning continuous post-training as the central compute metric for the agentic era.

items.title: LongStraw enables long-context RL beyond 2M tokens under fixed GPU budgets
items.summary: An architecture-aware execution stack decouples attention computation from GPU memory through strategic recomputation and ring-based context-parallelism, bridging the gap between long-context inference and short-context post-training.

items.title: Branching Policy Optimization replaces independent rollouts with a single tree
items.summary: BPO replaces PPO/GRPO's independent-trajectory topology with a branching tree using deterministic snapshottable sandboxes, improving success by 3.6-6.1 points on WebShop, ALFWorld, and SWE-bench Verified at matched compute.

items.title: SEED: Self-evolving on-policy distillation for agentic reinforcement learning
items.summary: A student LLM agent learns from its own on-policy rollouts via a teacher that bootstraps from the student's own episodic successes, filling the supervision gap between sparse trajectory rewards and token-level policy learning.

items.title: VideoChat3 brings fully open video MLLM for efficient generalist understanding
items.summary: An open-source video multimodal LLM that generalizes across diverse video types — motion, long video, streaming — while significantly reducing computational overhead compared to existing domain-specific models.

items.title: WanSong v1.0: diffusion-based music generation for commercial-grade song production
items.summary: A pure diffusion foundation model for long-form song generation that avoids autoregressive cascades, achieving efficient high-fidelity audio with controllability for music production.

items.title: Google rebrands NotebookLM to Gemini Notebook
items.summary: The popular AI research and note-taking tool gets a new name under the Gemini umbrella, aligning with Google's broader AI brand consolidation.

items.title: Anthropic's Claude gains native browser control
items.summary: Claude now has built-in browser capability, allowing it to navigate and interact with web pages autonomously and expanding its agentic capabilities.

items.title: Spotify rolls out new AI-powered features
items.summary: Spotify has deployed new generative AI capabilities on the music streaming platform, bringing AI-native interactions to its hundreds of millions of users.

items.title: Tokio team releases Topcoat, a full-stack Rust framework
items.summary: Topcoat is a full-stack Rust web framework with server-side rendering, client-side hydration, and integrated tooling from the Tokio team.

items.title: Capital One open-sources VulnHunter for agentic code security
items.summary: VulnHunter is an agentic AI tool that automatically finds and fixes security vulnerabilities in code, now available as open source.

items.title: Belfort Labs achieves homomorphically encrypted CIFAR-10 inference in 200ms
items.summary: Fully homomorphically encrypted neural network inference on CIFAR-10 completes in 200ms, a milestone for privacy-preserving AI deployment.

items.title: Isomorphic Labs unveils Drug Design Engine built on AlphaFold
items.summary: An AI platform extending AlphaFold capabilities to accelerate computational drug discovery, unlocking new frontiers in pharmaceutical AI.

items.title: Puter Labs ports Firefox to run inside WebAssembly
items.summary: A full Firefox browser runtime now runs inside WebAssembly within a browser, enabling development, testing, and sandboxing scenarios.
